entries.9faaab5512a654b0: This is the core business of the group, selling apparel, personal goods, miscellaneous goods, household goods and food products. In Japan, it is centered on Isetan Shinjuku Main Store, Mitsukoshi Nihonbashi Main Store and Mitsukoshi Ginza Store, and is operated by regional department store companies in Sapporo, Sendai, Nagoya, Hiroshima, Takamatsu, Matsuyama, Fukuoka and Niigata; it also has stores overseas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥446,776 million (down 2.5% year on year), accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue. The filing states that sales to domestic customers were firm, while sales to overseas customers fell below the previous year, due in part to a slowdown in the number of visitors to Japan since November 2025.
